criteria.criterion: Typed reference selectors resolve immutable pinned Git revisions with honest inventory vs sampling
criteria.evidence: resolveRuleReference (src/rules/references.ts#resolveRuleReference:24:1) resolves HEAD to a full 40-char SHA via git rev-parse, verifies clean checkout, builds per-file inventory with declarations, limits exemplars to 8, sets coverage='all' vs 'bounded', and marks approved=false. Test in tests/doctrine-management.test.ts ('typed pinned references distinguish complete inventory from bounded exemplars and remain unapproved') asserts reference.revision===git('rev-parse','HEAD'), coverage==='all', exemplars.length===2, approved===false, and that dirty/unauthorized/unsupported revisions throw. Test passed (test:tests/doctrine-management.test.ts).

criteria.criterion: Governed import/export executes atomic batch persistence with zero partial state on injected failure
criteria.evidence: RuleStore.saveBatch (src/rules/store.ts#RuleStore.saveBatch:79:3) calls this.store.sqliteStore.applyBatch([...records, ...auditRecords]) which uses a SQLite SAVEPOINT with ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT on error (node_modules/@dharmax/semantika/src/storage/sqlite-store/sqlite-store.ts#SqliteStore.applyBatch:76:5). Test 'Rule and audit persistence roll back together on real injected SQL failure' in tests/doctrine-management.test.ts installs a BEFORE INSERT trigger on aiwf_Artifact that raises ABORT, then calls applyPack and asserts it throws 'audit unavailable' and that listAllRules()==[] and listEntities(Artifact.dcr)==[]. Test passed (test:tests/doctrine-management.test.ts).

criteria.criterion: Unified management operations exposed across CLI, MCP, and shell-ui entity view
criteria.evidence: CLI: runRuleCommand (src/rule-command.ts#runRuleCommand:4:1) exposes list/get/export/preview/apply/resolve verbs. MCP: registerRuleTools (src/tools/rules.ts#registerRuleTools:13:1) registers list_rules, get_rule, export_rules, preview_rule_change, apply_rule_change, resolve_rule_reference; getPublicMcpTools verified to contain 'apply_rule_change'. Shell-UI: buildEntityView/saveEntityView (src/entity-view.ts) and presentEntityView (src/shell.ts#presentEntityView:44:1) expose rule view/edit with confirmation. Test 'CLI adapter, MCP tools and existing entity form share graph truth and explicit approval' in tests/doctrine-management.test.ts asserts all three surfaces and passed (test:tests/doctrine-management.test.ts).

rules.evidence: Each new symbol has a justified, non-duplicated owner: resolveRuleReference/validateReferenceSnapshot/renderRuleReferences live in src/rules/references.ts (reference domain); saveBatch/exportPack/previewPack/applyPack live in src/rules/store.ts (Rule persistence domain); runRuleCommand in src/rule-command.ts (CLI adapter); registerRuleTools in src/tools/rules.ts (MCP surface); buildEntityView/saveEntityView in src/entity-view.ts (view layer); presentEntityView in src/shell.ts (shell session). No duplicate registry or shadow store was introduced. The atomic batch delegates directly to the existing SqliteStore.applyBatch (node_modules/@dharmax/semantika/src/storage/sqlite-store/sqlite-store.ts#SqliteStore.applyBatch:76:5) rather than creating a new persistence layer.

Atomic persistence is achieved by passing a flat array of change records directly to the existing SqliteStore.applyBatch SAVEPOINT mechanism — no intermediate cache, shadow store, or async transaction wrapper. resolveRuleReference uses Bun.spawnSync git calls directly without an abstraction layer. previewPack/applyPack are a two-step preview-then-apply pattern with no intermediate state object beyond the fingerprint. The CLI adapter (runRuleCommand) is a thin switch over registry.execute calls. No unnecessary layers were introduced.

src/rules/references.ts owns only reference resolution/validation/rendering. src/rules/store.ts owns only Rule persistence (saveBatch, exportPack, previewPack, applyPack). src/rule-command.ts owns only CLI dispatch. src/tools/rules.ts owns only MCP tool registration. src/entity-view.ts owns only entity view construction/saving. src/shell.ts#presentEntityView owns only shell session presentation. No method has scattered responsibilities; each touched artifact has one clear owner. Tests confirm each surface independently (test:tests/doctrine-management.test.ts, test:tests/doctrine-batch.test.ts, test:tests/doctrine-management-live.test.ts).

The rule explicitly prohibits an AdditionRegistry forwarding to add as an unjustified duplicate owner, even if tests pass. method: Read-only grounding, assisted AIWF guarded implementation, native Ticket.resolve checks and real independent OpenRouter acceptance. No renewed broad producer run.
rootCause: Consumer wiring referenced nonexistent WorkflowStore exports and used unrelated CLI sync. The prior Ticket lacked code-target edges; textual safe_change did not verify import linkage. Exact model internal reasoning is not retained.
limits: Only explicitly authorized clean local Git checkouts; no clone or fetch.
Full structural inventories limited to 32 supported TS/JS files; at most eight 8000-character exemplars. Excluded/unsupported coverage is explicit; no repository-wide quality certification.
New source approval is revalidated against the pinned checkout; an existing approved saved snapshot remains usable offline. Private snapshots are omitted from exports unless explicitly exportable.
Nested Rule data uses the existing JSON form fields, with list filtering through shared commands; no new UI framework.
Atomic batch guarantee is SQLite-specific; the separate generic storage-session design remains unimplemented.
Managed Ticket mutation/acceptance is enforced; unrestricted host shell/native database edits remain outside that boundary.
Nineteen existing TypeScript diagnostics remain; no introduced diagnostic identities.
